summary: Implementation plan to deliver rich, evidence-based exercise variation across all 3 days of the Everyday Athlete split. Implements a dedicated full-body movement rotation matrix (Squat/Horizontal on Day 1, Hinge/Vertical on Day 2, Unilateral/Rotational & Engine on Day 3) with zero repetitive exercises, varied equipment (barbell, dumbbells, kettlebells, cables), and progressive 2-week block adaptations.
